queries_run: Deckers HOKA UGG wholesale DTC channel shift 2026

findings.claim: FY2026 批發淨銷售 +12.3% 至 $3.208B，DTC +6.3% 至 $2.264B；批發成長快於 DTC，HOKA 批發 +18.2%、DTC +12.0%，UGG 批發 +12.7%、DTC +3.6%。
公司長期策略仍是提高 DTC 占比，但為擴大品牌認知與市占也擴張批發，批發占比在特定期間可能上升並壓低毛利率。
findings.excerpt: Our long-term strategy is to grow our DTC channel to represent a larger portion of our total net sales by differentiating the consumer experience relative to the wholesale channel and driving consumer acquisition and retention.

findings.claim: Teva 將批發通路重新聚焦戶外與高端零售商，價值導向批發客群銷售下滑，Other brands 淨銷售 -33.9%。
findings.excerpt: We continue to take actions to reposition the Teva brand, including refocusing certain wholesale channel distribution toward outdoor and premium retail partners and emphasizing brand messaging around its outdoor-adventure heritage.

findings.claim: 截至 2026-03-31 共 203 家自營店（UGG 141、HOKA 62），電商網站涵蓋 54 國；UGG 批發通路分銷與產品分層持續檢討。
findings.excerpt: As of March 31, 2026, we have a total of 203 global Company-owned retail stores (including 141 UGG brand retail stores and 62 HOKA brand retail stores), which include 105 concept stores and 98 outlet stores.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 未找到訂閱化或平台化的商業模式轉移證據；僅批發／DTC 結構變化。聚合站摘要（UGG DTC 單季數字）互相矛盾，未採用。
